TITLE: Stationary of a Dream Courier
TEXT:
He arrives before the alarm—no shoes, only barcodes in his palms.
The letters he carries are not meant for names; they are envelopes of patience.
Open one and a small city spills out: a bus route that bends like a sigh,
a florist who sells verbs cheaper than roses, a pocket watch that counts
how many times you've paused between thoughts.
He does not accept tips. He is paid in sideways glances and the promise
to remember the color of the first river you ever walked beside.
